1.7.POSTPARTUM HEMORRHAGE
•Risk factors for PPH

Antenatal:

•Previous PPH requiring blood transfusion
•Placenta accreta spectrum
•Pre – Eclampsia
•Hb < 85 g/lit @ time of labor
•BMI > 35

Grand multi > 4 or more

•APH or abruption
•Existing uterine abnormalities like fibroids.
•Low lying placenta
•Use of SSRI or SNRI one month before delivery.

Intrapartum:

•IOL or Augmentation with oxytocin or prostaglandin
•Prolonged 1st or 2nd stage.
•Sepsis
•Oxytocin uses during labor
•Precipitated labor
•Instrumental birth
•Shoulder dystocia
•Delay in delivery of placenta.
